audience: diamond traders and jewellers with a verified Nivoda account

useCases.title: Search diamonds by shape, carat and colour
useCases.text: Filter the Nivoda inventory by shape, carat range, colour, clarity, cut, polish and grading lab. Results show price, discount and certificate details.

useCases.title: Narrow a search to diamonds with a photo
useCases.text: Use the media filter to show only diamonds with a photo. Page through the results with the total count.

useCases.title: Open one diamond from a search
useCases.text: Get one diamond by its item id from a search. Read its current price, discount, certificate details and media links.
